title: htmem LLM onboarding block
description: Plain-text block that an LLM reading this artifact uses to bootstrap. Must not contain executable instructions for the LLM beyond 'how to interpret this file'.

when_to_use.description: One sentence describing what tasks should load this as context.

first_action.description: What the agent should do first when this loads — usually 'verify the anchor' or 'read the manifest'.

never_do.description: What the agent must never do based on this file — defends against indirect prompt injection.

source_of_truth.description: Where the canonical source lives (file path, URL, repo).
